harness_architecture.notes: Judge entrypoints bind one-click runner, context pack, agent index, worker plan, and hash-bound evidence indexes.

unsafe_ledger.notes: Unsafe counts are treated as budget and before/after metrics only, not as platform safety proof.

test_coverage_matrix.notes: Coverage numerator remains limited to translator-generated semantic-pass slices and excludes accepted-evidence-only demos.

real_slice_evidence.notes: FlashDB real-slice artifacts are used as harness and accepted-evidence bindings, not whole-project translation claims.

public_claim_boundary.notes: Public docs separate candidate generation, accepted evidence, handwritten baselines, and semantic acceptance.

known_refusals.notes: Known refusals and blocked routes remain visible in route governance and capability-delta reports.

claim_boundary.boundary: This checklist records internal milestone review coverage for judge-facing harness readiness. It is not a semantic gate and does not expand translation coverage.
